description: The most flexible and the most comprehensible visual for reporting plans, schedules and roadmaps. Clearly presents your project/portfolio, product(s) or campaign plans, or plans of whatever else that can be time-scheduled. Present your phases as well as key milestones. All in a one-page or scrollable view. It doesn't matter how long period of time you need to show, or what you want to put focus on. Numerous formatting settings will adjust the graphics to your presentations and your company design needs. Version 3.2 brings to you these features: New menu structure – we adopted a modernized menu structure for better navigation through multiple settings Tree and Table hierarchy – expandable/collapsible levels within Left Axis with separate formatting and indentation, now with Table view to save precious space New bars shapes – process arrows, skewed rectangle, … Added field to easily map Additional column content - now, it can be also measures (with summary functions - sum, average, ...) and URL links Column titles/lables - Left Axis / Group / SubGroup can be labeled with separate formatting Sorting - new menu for sorting by date/time or alphabetically Target lines and Intervals – define multiple Target lines and Intervals in your source data Better text handling – text/labels truncating („xxxx…“) to fit the dedicated space (bars, etc.), line breaks for text content! Today focus…
